description: Java class 'AnyCommand' providing a GUI component for sending commands, with features like command history, input validation, and command preparation.

classes.name: AnyCommand
classes.description: A GUI component for executing commands with input validation, command history, and command processing features.

methods.name: installCtrlEnterAction
methods.description: Sets up Ctrl-Enter shortcut to trigger command sending.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Splits multiline input and sends each line as a command.

methods.name: sendCommand

methods.name: prepareEvalCommand
methods.description: Converts 'eval' command to 'rpn_eval' with infix to postfix conversion.

methods.name: infix2postfix
